title: Microsoft invests in and partners with OpenAI to support us building beneficial AGI
body: Microsoft is investing $1 billion in OpenAI to support us building artificial general intelligence (AGI) with widely distributed economic benefits. We’re partnering to develop a hardware and software platform within Microsoft Azure which will scale to AGI. We’ll jointly develop new Azure AI supercomputing technologies, and Microsoft will become our exclusive cloud provider—so we’ll be working hard together to further extend Microsoft Azure’s capabilities in large-scale AI systems.
summaryZh: 本文来自OpenAI，围绕“Microsoft invests in and partners with OpenAI to support us building beneficial AGI”介绍行业落地方面的最新进展，重点涉及OpenAI、Microsoft、行业应用。下方为系统保存的原文正文。
